enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Spearblock V: Passive: Reduces physical damage taken by 10, except from Bludgeoning or Slashing weapons. (Damage Reduction: 10/Slash, Bludgeon)
Axeblock V: Passive: Reduces physical damage taken by 10, except from Bludgeoning or Piercing weapons. (Damage Reduction: 10/Pierce, Bludgeon)
Hardened Exterior 1: You gain a +1 profane bonus to AC.

Orlassk's Prison: This shield radiates with the power of the Lord of Stone. A shield bash will turn the target to stone. This effect can trigger once ever 90 seconds. A successful Fortitude save (DC 65) negates this effect.
Stone Paws: In Animal Form, Gain +2[W] and DR 15/Adamantine.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
